tpf2-bigmap (silver2127), MIT License
Source: https://github.com/silver2127/tpf2-bigmap
Pinned commit: 4f0de6f ("release 0.4.0: material-index paging, terrain codec
format 3 and engine speedups")

Nothing from the plugin is vendored verbatim. The following files were ported
into TPF2MP, replacing the plugin-host ABI with the Host seam in
native/include/tpf2mp/native_terrain_fast.hpp and keeping the arithmetic
operation for operation:

  src/terrain_align_fast.h  -> native/src/native_terrain_fast.cpp (CalculateHeightMod)
  src/terrain_refine.h      -> native/src/native_terrain_fast.cpp (BicubicRefine)
  src/terrain_minmax.h      -> native/src/native_terrain_fast.cpp (MinMaxScan, BlockCopy)
  src/material_index.h      -> native/src/native_material_fast.cpp (MaterialIndex)
  tools/test_terrain_align_fast.py -> tests/native_terrain_fast/align_proof.py
  tools/test_terrain_refine.py     -> tests/native_terrain_fast/refine_proof.py
  tools/test_terrain_minmax.py     -> tests/native_terrain_fast/minmax_proof.py
  tools/test_material_index.py     -> tests/native_terrain_fast/material_proof.py

The Build 35924 byte regions those files pin (function bodies, constants and
vtables) are copied unchanged. LICENSE.txt beside this file is the upstream
license and ships in packaged releases as licenses/tpf2-bigmap-MIT.txt.
